outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic/diagram illustrating exposure-time overhead percentages, not a quantitative averaged plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time (mean±s.e.m. per condition); scatter plots are exempt since the plotted points are themselves the data.
Line plots showing individual cell migration tracks; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points, and in fact each line already represents a single cell.
Bar chart of migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) with individual data points (dots for each cell) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (MitoTracker/Paxillin/Merge), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Panel H shows a time-lapse series of micrographs, not a quantitative plot.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m.); line plots are exempt from requiring individual data points.
